proposed_patches.root_cause: Unconditional clear-yes transition preempts the rest of the confirmation utterance; commit/finalize pipeline has no subsequent conversational turn.
proposed_patches.snippet:
"Before transition_to_confirm_promises, answer any question included with the confirmation. "
"If they ask about changing or cancelling the promise once recorded, explain that a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call and they can change it in the mobile app. "
"If they instead request a new date or amount now, call assess with propose, read it back again and obtain confirmation. "
"Only transition when the current read-back is confirmed and no question or change remains unanswered.\n"
proposed_patches.transition_description: The current read-back is clearly confirmed, with no unanswered question and no requested change remaining.

proposed_patches.root_cause: Classifier does not explicitly distinguish inability to pay today/all today from unaffordability of the product full amount. Exact failed event was [too_much,all,null,null,empty].
proposed_patches.snippet:
"too_much": "explicitly says the product FULL AMOUNT is unaffordable or asks to pay a smaller part, without naming an amount. Not a refusal to pay today or all products today",
"refuse": "a clear no with no alternative date or amount. Includes I cannot pay all of that today and I cannot pay today. These are refusals, not too_much, unless they explicitly say the amount itself is too high",

proposed_patches.root_cause: One-event prompt permits all for heterogeneous multi-product utterances; policy faithfully closes all open products with that single paid reason. Exact failed event [situation,all,null,null,paid].
proposed_patches.snippet: "a_product": {"type": "string", "default": "{{a_product}}", "description": "One product id (p1, p2, ...). Use all only when the SAME event and SAME situation explicitly apply to EVERY unresolved product. Never include an unmentioned product or combine paid/disputed/refused products into all."},
proposed_patches.prompt_addition: "For mixed statements about different products, report only the current product with its own event and situation; retain the other clauses for those products’ turns. Never generalize one product’s payment to other products. A recent payment of arrears is paid; a product allegedly paid off or closed in the past is dispute. After settling the current product, use the remembered claim when that product is discussed; do not turn a historical payoff into paid.\n"
